in_english.name: Lazeezah
in_english.meaning: one who delights in the pleasure and joy of life
in_english.long_meaning: Lazeezah: a name that signifies one who delights in the pleasure and joy of life, and is associated with the Arabic root لَذّ which means to take pleasure in something. The root is also related to the concept of happiness and contentment. In Islamic tradition, the name Lazeezah is significant as it reflects the importance of finding joy and happiness in one's life. It is also associated with the idea of being grateful and appreciative of the blessings in life. Modern usage of the name Lazeezah can be seen in various Muslim cultures, where it is often given to girls born into families who value the importance of happiness and contentment.
